text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is here. Sakura Chiyono O and I have been training as hard as we possibly can without overstraining her body.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've memorized everything I learned during training up till today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, just you watch! I'm going to aim for first today too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is trying to act like her usual self, the way she was before admitting her worries about being past her peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But even if it is just an act to hide how she really feels, if she wants me to act like normal, then all I can do is honor her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Heh. It never really feels like the race is about to start until you wish me good luck.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We've done everything we could for the Takarazuka Kinen, and I'm going to show you just how much our hard work has paid off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking, you see. Even if it's true that my peak really has passed…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As long as I keep looking forward and working hard, I'll still be able to accomplish plenty of things!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In fact, I have no intention of losing to anyone today, no matter who I'm racing against!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen is here, and so are the dashing Umamusume who are going to run in it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: But who among them will claim glory today? Hold on tight, folks, because the race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno… She must be even stronger than she was during the Classics.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Bamboo has grown by leaps and bounds too. There's no doubt just how powerful her running will be today.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Inari's been attracting lots of attention since the beginning of the year, which means her abilities must be the real deal…)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …It's okay. I'm going to be okay!
